_comment: Cards that exist only for the announced-X-life test (tests/unit/costs/test_pay_x_life.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_toxic_deluge` is Toxic Deluge's shape. `t_fixed_deluge` is the card the DSL could write before this existed -- a fixed 3 life and a fixed -3/-3 -- and is the counterfactual that cannot be aimed.

cards.name: Test Toxic Deluge
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
All creatures get -X/-X until end of turn.

cards.name: Test Fixed Deluge
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay 3 life.
All creatures get -3/-3 until end of turn.
